description: Hochsauerlandkreis Wasserschutzgebiete is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gis.hochsauerlandkreis.de. Water protection areas in the Hochsauerland district as surface-shaped objects. Water protection areas (WSG) are areas in which special laws and prohibitions apply to protect waters from harmful influences. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Hochsauerlandkreis Water protection areas" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Hochsauerlandkreis, Wasserschutzgebiete, HSK, WSG, opendata. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
